Working with **film-crew** (single-shot) → **banana-pro-director-2.0**, which runs in stylized mode for children's work.

**Session notes:** This workspace isn't a git repo and has no `NOTES.md`, so I couldn't pull or check for open items. I didn't change any files, so there's nothing to commit.

**Assumptions** (I couldn't find a character bible for the series, so I designed the kids myself):
- **Մտմտիկ** is the thinker: a girl of about 6 with a pencil behind her ear, looking up and asking.
- **Պրպտիկ** is the explorer: a boy of about 6 with a magnifying glass and a rumpled explorer hat, kneeling and digging in.
- **Title:** Nano Banana Pro is unreliable with Armenian letters. The main prompt leaves clean sky at the top so you can add the title as a layout overlay. Version B asks the model to draw the title, as a test only.

**Crew plan (single shot)**
- **Director:** The poster shows the moment a question is born. One child points at the sky and the other peers into the grass, so the whole world looks like something to ask about. Hidden question-mark shapes reward a second look.
- **Design and costume:** A sunny Armenian hillside with an apricot tree, a soft snow-capped double-peaked mountain on the far horizon and a red kite whose string curls into a question mark. Girl: yellow raincoat-style jacket, striped tights, two puffy pigtails. Boy: green overalls, rolled sleeves, an oversized safari hat and one muddy knee.
- **DP:** Eye level at the kids' height, a medium-wide two-shot with the kids in the lower half and the top third left as open sky. Soft late-morning sun from frame-left. Warm apricot, sky blue, grass green and sunflower yellow, with one red accent on the kite (studio red #D90429). The grade is bright, soft and low-contrast.

## FINAL

**Settings:** Nano Banana Pro · aspect ratio 4:5 (set it in the UI) · 2K or higher · no reference images (add your character sheets first if they exist) · text-to-image

**A — Main (clean sky at the top for the title overlay)**
```
Warm hand-painted storybook illustration for a children's poster, soft gouache and colored-pencil texture, rounded friendly shapes, gentle visible brush strokes, bright cheerful palette of apricot orange, sky blue, fresh grass green and sunflower yellow, with one vivid red accent.

Two curious six-year-old children on a sunny grassy hillside, medium-wide two-shot, both placed in the lower half of the frame, the upper third an open soft blue sky with a few puffy clouds and clean empty space.

On the left, a little girl stands on tiptoe pointing up at the sky with one hand, the other hand on her chin in a thinking pose, eyes wide and mouth in a small round "oh" of wonder; two puffy dark pigtails, rosy cheeks, a short sunflower-yellow jacket, a blue-and-white striped top, striped tights, red sneakers, a pencil tucked behind her ear.

On the right, a little boy kneels in the grass leaning close to a ladybug on a dandelion, peering through a big round magnifying glass that makes one eye look huge and funny; messy brown curls under an oversized khaki explorer hat, grass-green overalls with rolled sleeves, a small backpack with a notebook sticking out, one muddy knee.

A bright red kite floats above them, its string curling through the air into the shape of a big question mark. Small hidden question-mark shapes in the scene: a curled snail shell, a twisting vine, a cloud. Behind them an apricot tree heavy with orange fruit, a butterfly, and far away on the horizon a soft pale snow-capped double-peaked mountain.

Soft late-morning sunlight from the left, warm glow on the faces, gentle soft shadows, airy and joyful mood, clear readable silhouettes, eye-level view at the children's height, picture-book quality for children ages 4 to 8, no text, no letters, no logos.
```

**B — Test only: the model draws the title (check every letter before using it)**
```
Warm hand-painted storybook illustration for a children's poster, soft gouache and colored-pencil texture, rounded friendly shapes, gentle visible brush strokes, bright cheerful palette of apricot orange, sky blue, fresh grass green and sunflower yellow, with one vivid red accent.

At the top of the poster, a large playful hand-lettered title in Armenian script reading exactly «Մտմտիկ և Պրպտիկ», chunky rounded bouncy letters in sunflower yellow with a thick dark outline, the red kite string curling around the title into the shape of a question mark.

Below the title, two curious six-year-old children on a sunny grassy hillside, medium-wide two-shot, both placed in the lower half of the frame.

On the left, a little girl stands on tiptoe pointing up at the sky with one hand, the other hand on her chin in a thinking pose, eyes wide and mouth in a small round "oh" of wonder; two puffy dark pigtails, rosy cheeks, a short sunflower-yellow jacket, a blue-and-white striped top, striped tights, red sneakers, a pencil tucked behind her ear.

On the right, a little boy kneels in the grass leaning close to a ladybug on a dandelion, peering through a big round magnifying glass that makes one eye look huge and funny; messy brown curls under an oversized khaki explorer hat, grass-green overalls with rolled sleeves, a small backpack with a notebook sticking out, one muddy knee.

A bright red kite floats above them. Small hidden question-mark shapes in the scene: a curled snail shell, a twisting vine, a cloud. Behind them an apricot tree heavy with orange fruit, a butterfly, and far away on the horizon a soft pale snow-capped double-peaked mountain.

Soft late-morning sunlight from the left, warm glow on the faces, gentle soft shadows, airy and joyful mood, clear readable silhouettes, eye-level view at the children's height, picture-book quality for children ages 4 to 8, no other text.
```

**Checks after generating:**
- **Title:** If B misspells any letter, use A and set the title in layout.
- **Faces:** Both kids should look like friendly cartoon characters, not real children.
- **Kite:** The red kite should be the only strong red in the image.
- **Top space:** In A, the sky at the top should be empty so the title fits.
